description.value: Donair Affair is a counter-service fast-food restaurant operating in a commercial strip mall at 32500 South Fraser Way in Abbotsford. The business has maintained a continuous Fraser Health Authority inspection record since at least 2018, most recently receiving a low hazard rating in November 2025. Cyclists travelling the South Fraser Way corridor in Abbotsford would find it a quick-stop option in a dense commercial area.

address.value: 210 - 32500 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2T 4W1

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 60m; rack (2 spaces) at 87m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record assigns this business to 'Chilliwack' but the coordinates (49.0498, -122.3238) place it in Abbotsford, which is confirmed by the Fraser Health Authority inspection records showing the address as 210 - 32500 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2T 4W1. The OSM 'website' URL points to a health authority inspection database, not a business website, providing no usable amenity evidence — only an address and a phone number extracted from inspection report headers. No cyclist-relevant amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) could be confirmed from either source.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but coordinates (49.0498, -122.3238) and Fraser Health Authority records confirm the location is in Abbotsford (210-32500 South Fraser Way), not Chilliwack.
The OSM 'website' URL links to a Fraser Health Authority food inspection database, not the business's own website; no actual business website has been identified.
OSM cuisine tag is 'sandwich' but the business name and inspection context suggest donair, indicating a likely OSM data error.

At least two distinct Donair Affair locations exist in Abbotsford (210-32500 South Fraser Way and 102A-2100 Whatcom Rd); this record corresponds to the South Fraser Way location based on addr:unit H210.
Phone number (604) 760-0861 was sourced from the health inspection report header, not from OSM or a verified business website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is actively operating (health inspection as recently as November 2025) but the OSM record contains significant data quality issues — wrong community field, no business website, and no address — leaving all WWC amenity criteria unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.notes: Address and phone were derived from the Fraser Health Authority inspection report, as OSM provides only an addr:unit tag (H210) and no phone or street address.
